shortDescription: Tail a logfile until a regex matcher is found or a timeout triggers

options.name: delay
options.description: How many seconds to wait after opening the file before starting to look for the regex.

options.name: from_regex
options.description: Backwards from end of file, lines preceeding this string will not be considered for matching regex. By default, the whole file is read. If `$` is used, start from the first line written after the file is opened.

options.name: path
options.description: The file on the remote system to tail.

options.name: regex
options.description: The string or regular expression to search in the file.

options.name: timeout
options.description: After how many seconds to exit unsuccessfully without having found the search regex.
